items.content_snippet: Amazon RDS for Oracle now lets you copy the option group associated with a DB snapshot when you copy that snapshot to another AWS Region. items.title: How Mozilla strengthens Firefox security with GPT-6 Cyber
items.content_snippet: Mozilla used GPT-6 Cyber to uncover previously unknown high-severity vulnerabilities in Firefox and identify architectural improvements. Its team shipped fixes to millions of users, turning findings into protections for the people who depend on the software. Hear Brian Grinstead, Distinguished Engineer for Firefox, share Mozilla’s experience and what stronger AI can mean for software defense. https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-cyber/

When you need details to stay consistent across edits, use Sunburst at medium or high quality. items.title: How We Took an AI Agent From 41% to 97% Accurate - Milind Sunil Shah, Brainbase Labs
items.content_snippet: Milind Sunil Shah of Brainbase Labs walks through a six-step framework for improving back-office agents, using a Domino's project that tracks competitors' pizza prices across websites and delivery apps.
